# 74150 - Data selector/multiplexer 16-1

Package DIP-24 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74150.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74150.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 28 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74150 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74150.png) | ![74150 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74150.png) | ![74150 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74150.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | W = NOT(STROBE' AND ((D' AND C' AND B' AND A' AND E0) OR (D' AND C' AND B' AND A AND E1) OR (D' AND C' AND B AND A' AND E2) OR (D' AND C' AND B AND A AND E3) OR (D' AND C AND B' AND A' AND E4) OR (D' AND C AND B' AND A AND E5) OR (D' AND C AND B AND A' AND E6) OR (D' AND C AND B AND A AND E7) OR (D AND C' AND B' AND A' AND E8) OR (D AND C' AND B' AND A AND E9) OR (D AND C' AND B AND A' AND E10) OR (D AND C' AND B AND A AND E11) OR (D AND C AND B' AND A' AND E12) OR (D AND C AND B' AND A AND E13) OR (D AND C AND B AND A' AND E14) OR (D AND C AND B AND A AND E15))) | With STROBE low, W is the complement of the data input E0-E15 picked by D,C,B,A (D most significant). STROBE high forces W high. |
